```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(brms)
library(ggdist)
library(cmdstanr)
library(patchwork)
library(splines)

# OPTIMIZE PERFORMANCE 
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores(), brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
cache_dir <- here::here("local_temp_data", "simulation_test")
if(!dir.exists(cache_dir)) {
  dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

source(here::here("R/utils", "data_prep.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils", "simulate_data.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils", "effect_functions.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils", "sampling_parallel.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils", "brm_parallel.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils", "cluster.R")) #set up future package 

setup_cluster(max_server_workers = 100)
```

```{r}
#LOAD DATA
proact <- read_csv(here::here("private_data/F_PROACT_ALSFRS.csv"))
proact_standardized <- data_prep(proact)
```

## Simulate data

```{r}
# SIMULATION SCENARIO
#co všechno můžu variovat:
#n_pacientů 
#eff_prob 
#tvar trajektorie pacientů (počet pozorování na každého pacienta)
#no. of questions 

nsims = 2
n_subj_per_group <- 10
eff_probs <- rep(c(0.5, 0.8), times = nsims) 
question_col_names <- sprintf("Q%02d", 1:12)
questions_to_fit <- question_col_names
```

```{r}
# SIMULATE DATA 
set.seed(468652233)


sims <- list()
for(i in 1:length(eff_probs)) {
    sims[[i]] <- simulate_data_from_registry(proact_standardized,
                                             max_duration = 12,
                                             min_measurements_per_subject = 4,
                                             max_measurements_per_subject = 8,
                                             n_subjects_per_group = n_subj_per_group,
                                             effect_prob = eff_probs[i])
}
```

## LMMS

### Lme4 Simple

```{r}

# FIT SIMPLE LMER MODEL
fits_lmer_simple <- purrr::map(sims, function(data_for_lmer) {
       data_for_lmer$alsfrs_sum_subset <- rowSums(data_for_lmer[, questions_to_fit])
  lme4::lmer(alsfrs_sum_subset ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths*group+ (1 |subject_id), data = data_for_lmer)
})

effects_lmer_simple <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_probs), 
                                     ~ cbind(data.frame(id = .x, type = "lmer4_simple", eff_prob = eff_probs[.x], effects_lmer(fits_lmer_simple[[.x]]))))


```

```{r}

# COMPUTE THE EFFECTS AND ORGANIZE THEM IN A SINGLE DATAFRAME 
fits_lmer_simple_rslope  <- purrr::map(sims, function(data_for_lmer) {
    data_for_lmer$alsfrs_sum_subset <-  rowSums(data_for_lmer[, questions_to_fit])
    lme4::lmer(alsfrs_sum_subset ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths*group+ (1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths |subject_id), data = data_for_lmer)
})

effects_lmer_simple_rslope <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_probs), 
                             ~ cbind(data.frame(id = .x, type = "lmer4_simple_rslope", eff_prob = eff_probs[.x], effects_lmer(fits_lmer_simple_rslope[[.x]]))))

```

### Lme4 Splines

```{r}

get_spline_coeffs <- function(x) {
  res <- ns(x, knots = 6, Boundary.knots = c(0, 12))
  colnames(res) <- paste0("dly_mnths_spline_", 1:ncol(res))
  res
}

fits_lmer_spline <- purrr::map(sims, function(data_for_lmer) {
    
     spline_data <- ns(data_for_lmer$alsfrs_dly_mnths, 2)
         data_for_lmer <- cbind(data_for_lmer,
                           get_spline_coeffs(data_for_lmer$alsfrs_dly_mnths))
         
             data_for_lmer$alsfrs_sum_subset <- rowSums(data_for_lmer[, questions_to_fit])
     
  lme4::lmer(alsfrs_sum_subset ~ 1 + dly_mnths_spline_1 * group
             + dly_mnths_spline_2 * group + (1 |subject_id), data = data_for_lmer)
})

effects_lmer_spline <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_probs), 
                                      ~ cbind(data.frame(id = .x, type = "lmer4_splines", eff_prob = eff_probs[.x], effects_lmer_splines(fits_lmer_spline[[.x]]))))


```

```{r}

fits_lmer_spline_rslope <- purrr::map(sims, function(data_for_lmer) {
    
    spline_data <- ns(data_for_lmer$alsfrs_dly_mnths, 2)
    data_for_lmer <- cbind(data_for_lmer,
                           get_spline_coeffs(data_for_lmer$alsfrs_dly_mnths))
    
    data_for_lmer$alsfrs_sum_subset <- rowSums(data_for_lmer[, questions_to_fit])
    
    lme4::lmer(alsfrs_sum_subset ~ 1 + dly_mnths_spline_1 * group
               + dly_mnths_spline_2 * group + (1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths |subject_id), data = data_for_lmer)
})

effects_lmer_spline_rslope <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_probs), 
                             ~ cbind(data.frame(id = .x, type = "lmer4_splines_rslope", eff_prob = eff_probs[.x], effects_lmer_splines(fits_lmer_spline_rslope[[.x]]))))
```

## Logit

### Linear

```{r}
#PARAMETERS OF A BAYESIAN FITTING
#args shared for all logit fits 
args_sh = list(adapt_delta = 0.8,
                init = 0.1,
                chains = 2,
                iter = 2000,
                warmup = 1000)

args_per_fit <- list()
for(i in 1:length(sims)) {
    data_for_fit <- sims[[i]] %>%
        mutate(across(all_of(question_col_names), function(x) { x + 1 }))
    args_per_fit[[i]] <- list(data = data_for_fit)
}

```

```{r}

#RANDOM INTERCEPT
logit_formula <- as.formula(paste0(
    "mvbind(", paste0(questions_to_fit, collapse = ", "),
    ") ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths*group + (1 | p | subject_id)"
))

summary_logit <- brm_parallel(
    args_shared = c(list(formula = bf(logit_formula, family = cumulative()) + set_rescor(FALSE)), 
                    args_sh),
    args_per_fit = args_per_fit[1],
    cache_dir = cache_dir,
    cache_fits = TRUE,
    cache_summaries = TRUE,
    summarise_fun = effect_from_sim_study,
    future.globals = list("effect_from_sim_study" = effect_from_sim_study))

effects_logit <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_probs), 
                                   ~ data.frame(id = .x, type = "logit", eff_prob = eff_probs[.x], estimate = summary_logit[[.x]]$effect_samples))

```

```{r}

#RANDOM SLOPE 
logit_formula_rslope <- as.formula(paste0(
    "mvbind(", paste0(questions_to_fit, collapse = ", "),
    ") ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths*group + (1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths | p | subject_id)"))

summary_logit_rslope <- brm_parallel(
    args_shared = c(list(formula = bf(logit_formula_rslope, family = cumulative()) + set_rescor(FALSE)), 
                    args_sh),
    args_per_fit = args_per_fit[1],
    cache_dir = cache_dir,
    cache_fits = TRUE,
    cache_summaries = TRUE,
    summarise_fun = effect_from_sim_study,
    future.globals = list("effect_from_sim_study" = effect_from_sim_study))

effects_logit_rslope <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_probs), 
                               ~ data.frame(id = .x, type = "logit_rslope", eff_prob = eff_probs[.x], estimate = summary_logit_rslope[[.x]]$effect_samples))


```

### Linear + DISC

```{r}

                         family = cumulative("logit", link_disc = "log")) + set_rescor(FALSE)), 
                    args_sh),
    args_per_fit = args_per_fit,
    cache_dir = cache_dir,
    cache_fits = TRUE,
    cache_summaries = TRUE,

                                   ~ data.frame(id = .x, type = "logit_disc", eff_prob = eff_probs[.x], estimate = summary_logit_disc[[.x]]$effect_samples))

make_stancode(formula = bf(logit_formula, disc ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths,
                           family = cumulative("logit", link_disc = "log")) + set_rescor(FALSE),
data = args_per_fit[[1]]$data)

    
    

```

## Results

```{r}
#FUNCTION BRMS 
summarise_brms <- function(all_effects) {
    all_effects %>% group_by(type, eff_prob, id) %>%
        summarise(lower95 = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
                  lower50 = quantile(estimate, 0.25),
                  upper50 = quantile(estimate, 0.75),
                  upper95 = quantile(estimate, 0.975),
                  estimate = mean(estimate),
                  .groups = "drop")
}
```

```{r}
my_pos <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

#PLOT
rbind(effects_lmer_simple,
      effects_lmer_simple_rslope,
      effect_lmer_spline,
      effect_lmer_spline_rslope,
      summarise_brms(effects_logit),
      summarise_brms(effects_logit_rslope),
      summarise_brms(effects_logit_disc),
      summarise_brms(effects_logit_rslope_disc),
      summarise_brms(effects_logit_TPR),
      summarise_brms(effects_logit_rslope_TPR),
      summarise_brms(effects_logit_TPR_disc),
      summarise_brms(effects_logit_rslope_TPR_disc),
      ) %>%
    mutate(eff_prob = factor(eff_prob)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(id), group = interaction(id, type), color = type)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower50, ymax = upper50), size = 1.2, position = my_pos) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower95, ymax = upper95), position = my_pos) +
    geom_point(aes(y = estimate), position = my_pos, size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~eff_prob, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank())


    
```
